notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-bdc279dc42dc, DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2017.01436, PMCID PMC5540951. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the Amazon River plume zooplankton study.
source_text: The V4 hypervariable region of 16S rRNA genes was targeted with 515F and 805R primers for PCR reactions using GoTaq Green Master Mix (Promega). PCR reactions were performed as follows: an initial denaturing step for 3 min at 95 C, then 30 cycles of 30 s at 95 C, 1 min at 55 C, 1 min at 72 C, and finally at 72 C for 5 min. Amplicons were sequenced using the Ion Torrent PGM sequencer (Life Technologies).
